obligations.expected_behavior: A Stable Package has a verifiable provenance reference for source-supported existing behavior and an immutable identity bound before the run.
forbidden_result: A Stable Package is accepted without verifiable provenance for source-supported existing behavior.
A Stable Package identity is not bound before the run.
obligations.observable_result: Stable-package eligibility evidence records a verifiable provenance reference and a pre-run immutable identity.
obligations.state_after: The Stable Package is eligible only with source-supported provenance and a pre-run immutable identity.
obligations.state_before: Stable-package provenance and pre-run identity eligibility have not been established.
obligations.subject: Stable Package eligibility
obligations.trigger: A Stable Package is selected for a Matrix run.

obligations.expected_behavior: The Candidate Package contains the real change under evaluation.
forbidden_result: A Candidate Package without the real change under evaluation is accepted as the Candidate.
obligations.observable_result: Candidate-package evidence identifies the real change under evaluation in the executed Candidate.
obligations.state_after: The executed Candidate Package contains the real evaluated change.
obligations.state_before: Candidate-package correspondence to the real evaluated change has not been established.
obligations.subject: Candidate Package eligibility
obligations.trigger: A Candidate Package is selected for a Matrix run.

obligations.expected_behavior: Each Probe independently binds its input, actual target, command, result, and output evidence.
forbidden_result: A Probe omits binding of its input, actual target, command, result, or output evidence.
A Probe reuses another Probe's bindings as its own independent evidence.
obligations.observable_result: Each Probe receipt contains independently attributable input, actual-target, command, result, and output-evidence bindings.
obligations.state_after: Every Probe has complete independent execution bindings.
obligations.state_before: Probe records may not bind every required execution element independently.
obligations.subject: Probe execution evidence
obligations.trigger: A detached Probe is executed or evaluated.

obligations.expected_behavior: The Matrix invalid-package case does not substitute for the detached Probe oracle.
forbidden_result: An invalid-package Matrix Case is accepted as proof of the detached Probe oracle.
obligations.observable_result: Validation distinguishes detached Probe-oracle evidence from invalid-package Matrix-Case evidence and rejects substitution.
obligations.state_after: Probe-oracle proof remains independently executed and cannot be supplied by a Matrix Case.
obligations.state_before: An invalid-package Matrix Case could be treated as a substitute for Probe-oracle evidence.
obligations.subject: Probe-oracle independence
obligations.trigger: Probe-oracle or invalid-package Matrix evidence is evaluated.

obligations.expected_behavior: The closed Matrix Case set exercises valid package, invalid package, historical compatibility, dirty baseline, knowledge read-set collision, and closed-policy architecture-index gap semantic distinctions.
forbidden_result: Any named Matrix semantic distinction is omitted.
A Matrix Case outside the closed set replaces a required named semantic distinction.
obligations.observable_result: Matrix evidence contains one executed case for each of the six named semantic distinctions.
obligations.state_after: All six required Matrix semantic distinctions have been exercised.
obligations.state_before: The required closed Matrix Case set has not been completely exercised.
obligations.subject: Closed Matrix Case set
obligations.trigger: The Replay Matrix is executed or evaluated.

obligations.expected_behavior: A Matrix Case reports `expected-difference` only when that difference is frozen for that case and all execution and evidence gates pass; it cannot approve a regression.
forbidden_result: `expected-difference` is reported without a frozen case-specific expectation.
`expected-difference` is accepted when execution or evidence gates fail.
`expected-difference` approves a regression.
obligations.observable_result: An `expected-difference` result is accompanied by its frozen case expectation and passing execution and evidence gates, without accepting regression.
obligations.state_after: Expected-difference handling is case-frozen, fully gated, and non-regressive.
obligations.state_before: An expected-difference result may lack a frozen case expectation or complete gate validation.
obligations.subject: Matrix expected-difference handling
obligations.trigger: A Matrix Case produces or evaluates `expected-difference`.

obligations.expected_behavior: Each Consumer binds its actual interface, input, command, output, result, and dependencies.
forbidden_result: A Consumer record omits its actual interface, input, command, output, result, or dependencies.
Declared rather than actual Consumer execution is accepted as a binding.
obligations.observable_result: Each Consumer execution receipt records its actual interface, input, command, output, result, and dependencies.
obligations.state_after: Every Consumer execution has complete actual-execution identity bindings.
obligations.state_before: Consumer execution records may not contain all required actual-execution bindings.
obligations.subject: Consumer execution identity
obligations.trigger: A Consumer route is executed or evaluated.

obligations.expected_behavior: During disable, every applicable real Consumer invokes the Prior Route and reproduces the Prior Route identity and Prior Behavior Baseline verdict and diagnostic category for every applicable fixture.
forbidden_result: Disable does not invoke the Prior Route through a real Consumer.
Disable fails to reproduce the Prior Route identity, verdict, or diagnostic category for an applicable fixture.
Configuration-only disable is accepted as Prior Route reproduction.
obligations.observable_result: Per-Consumer disable receipts show a real Prior Route invocation and the required identity, verdict, and diagnostic-category reproduction for every applicable fixture.
obligations.state_after: Every applicable Consumer has completed disable through the Prior Route with required per-fixture reproduction.
obligations.state_before: Disable has not demonstrated Prior Route execution and baseline reproduction for every applicable fixture.
obligations.subject: Disable transition
obligations.trigger: A disable transition is executed for an applicable Consumer.

obligations.expected_behavior: During rollback, every applicable real Consumer invokes the Prior Route and reproduces the Prior Route identity and Prior Behavior Baseline verdict and diagnostic category for every applicable fixture.
forbidden_result: Rollback does not invoke the Prior Route through a real Consumer.
Rollback fails to reproduce the Prior Route identity, verdict, or diagnostic category for an applicable fixture.
Configuration-only rollback is accepted as Prior Route reproduction.
obligations.observable_result: Per-Consumer rollback receipts show a real Prior Route invocation and the required identity, verdict, and diagnostic-category reproduction for every applicable fixture.
obligations.state_after: Every applicable Consumer has completed rollback through the Prior Route with required per-fixture reproduction.
obligations.state_before: Rollback has not demonstrated Prior Route execution and baseline reproduction for every applicable fixture.
obligations.subject: Rollback transition
obligations.trigger: A rollback transition is executed for an applicable Consumer.

obligations.expected_behavior: Every behavioral duty has its own observable independent fault witness.
forbidden_result: A behavioral duty lacks an observable independent fault witness.
One fault witness is treated as proving another behavioral duty without independent observation.
obligations.observable_result: Exact Cover evidence maps each behavioral duty to its own observable independent fault witness.
obligations.state_after: Each behavioral duty has an independently observable fault witness.
obligations.state_before: Behavioral duties may lack independently observable fault witnesses.
obligations.subject: Behavioral-duty fault witnesses
obligations.trigger: Exact Cover is built or verified.

obligations.expected_behavior: Every non-behavioral duty has a deterministic violation witness.
forbidden_result: A non-behavioral duty lacks a deterministic violation witness.
A non-deterministic or aggregate-only witness is accepted for a non-behavioral duty.
obligations.observable_result: Exact Cover evidence maps each non-behavioral duty to a deterministic violation witness.
obligations.state_after: Each non-behavioral duty has a deterministic violation witness.
obligations.state_before: Non-behavioral duties may lack deterministic violation witnesses.
obligations.subject: Non-behavioral-duty violation witnesses
obligations.trigger: Exact Cover is built or verified.

obligations.expected_behavior: Existing passing brownfield behavior receives truthful characterization and a distinct fault witness before production behavior changes.
forbidden_result: A production behavior change proceeds for existing passing brownfield behavior without truthful characterization.
A production behavior change proceeds for existing passing brownfield behavior without a distinct fault witness.
obligations.observable_result: Pre-change evidence truthfully characterizes existing passing brownfield behavior and contains a distinct fault witness.
obligations.state_after: Existing passing brownfield behavior is truthfully characterized with a distinct fault witness before production behavior changes.
obligations.state_before: Existing passing brownfield behavior has not yet been truthfully characterized with a distinct fault witness.
obligations.subject: Brownfield defect characterization
obligations.trigger: A production behavior change is prepared for existing passing brownfield behavior.

obligations.expected_behavior: Fabricated RED evidence and post-hoc failure evidence are invalid.
forbidden_result: Fabricated RED evidence is accepted.
Post-hoc failure evidence is accepted.
obligations.observable_result: Evidence validation rejects fabricated RED evidence and post-hoc failure evidence.
obligations.state_after: Fabricated and post-hoc failure evidence cannot establish required defect-revealing test discipline.
obligations.state_before: Failure evidence authenticity and timing have not been validated.
obligations.subject: Defect-revealing failure evidence
obligations.trigger: RED or failure evidence is evaluated.

obligations.expected_behavior: TC-D1 does not create a quality baseline.
forbidden_result: TC-D1 creates or accepts a quality baseline.
obligations.observable_result: Scope validation rejects TC-D1 work that creates or accepts a quality baseline.
obligations.state_after: TC-D1 work proceeds without creating a quality baseline.
obligations.state_before: A proposed TC-D1 change may attempt to create a quality baseline.
obligations.subject: Quality-baseline boundary
obligations.trigger: TC-D1 scope or implementation work is evaluated.

obligations.expected_behavior: TC-D1 does not admit evaluation-set members.
forbidden_result: TC-D1 admits or accepts an evaluation-set member.
obligations.observable_result: Scope validation rejects TC-D1 work that admits an evaluation-set member.
obligations.state_after: TC-D1 work proceeds without admitting evaluation-set members.
obligations.state_before: A proposed TC-D1 change may attempt to admit an evaluation-set member.
obligations.subject: Evaluation-set admission boundary
obligations.trigger: TC-D1 scope or implementation work is evaluated.

obligations.expected_behavior: A current equivalent replay of historical evidence creates new process evidence and states its equivalence boundary.
forbidden_result: A current equivalent replay relies only on historical process evidence.
A current equivalent replay omits its equivalence boundary.
obligations.observable_result: Current equivalent replay evidence includes newly created process evidence and an explicit equivalence-boundary statement.
obligations.state_after: The current equivalent replay has fresh process evidence and a stated equivalence boundary.
obligations.state_before: Historical evidence exists, but a current equivalent replay has not established its fresh process evidence and equivalence boundary.
obligations.subject: Historical equivalent replay
obligations.trigger: A current equivalent replay of historical evidence is executed.

obligations.expected_behavior: Only the current Acceptance lifecycle owner may publish `acceptance-passed` after required independent review and scoped approval.
forbidden_result: A non-current Acceptance lifecycle owner publishes `acceptance-passed`.
`acceptance-passed` is published without required independent review.
`acceptance-passed` is published without scoped approval.
obligations.observable_result: Acceptance publication records identify the current Acceptance lifecycle owner and bind required independent-review and scoped-approval preconditions.
obligations.state_after: `acceptance-passed` can be published only by the current Acceptance lifecycle owner after required independent review and scoped approval.
obligations.state_before: Acceptance-publication preconditions have not been verified.
obligations.subject: Acceptance-passed publication
obligations.trigger: Publication of `acceptance-passed` is requested or evaluated.
